tokoh_utama: A 22-year-old Indonesian man with short messy black hair, wearing a dark blue t-shirt and grey sweatpants.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu dapat voice note begini, kamu tanya pacarmu atau diam aja?
part.caption: Mendapat pesan suara misterius jam 3 pagi yang durasinya berubah sendiri... Siapa yang merekam?

adegan.narasi: Pacarku mendadak kirim voice note jam tiga pagi saat kamarku sangat sepi.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a smartphone screen lying on a wooden desk in a dim bedroom showing a message app interface with a audio message received at 03:00 AM.

adegan.narasi: Durasi pesan suara itu cuma nol titik empat puluh tujuh detik, isinya suara napas.
adegan.gambar: A young Indonesian man sitting on his bed in a dark bedroom, holding his glowing phone screen close to his face with a confused expression.

adegan.narasi: Pagi harinya dia bersumpah sudah tidur nyenyak dari jam sembilan malam kemarin.
adegan.gambar: Split view: daylight room with young man texting on phone with worried face, contrasting with night memory.

adegan.narasi: Penasaran, aku putar ulang pesan itu pakai headphone sambil menyalakan kipas angin.
adegan.gambar: The young man sitting at his desk wearing headphones, dimly lit by desk lamp. In the background window gap, a tall faint shadowy silhouette stands outside.

adegan.narasi: Samar-samar di balik suara napas, terdengar suara langkah kaki pelan mendekat.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of headphones lying on the wooden desk, glowing dark red atmosphere around the desk.

adegan.narasi: Aku merinding hebat saat sadar ritme langkah itu sangat mirip langkah kakiku.
adegan.gambar: The young man pulling his headphones down to his neck, wide eyes filled with fear looking over his shoulder.

adegan.narasi: Keraguan membuatku membuka aplikasi pesan lagi untuk mengecek durasi file tersebut.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of fingers tapping the glowing phone screen displaying the chat window.

adegan.narasi: Anehnya, durasi voice note itu mendadak berubah sendiri jadi nol titik lima puluh dua.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the phone screen showing audio length timestamp glitched from 0:47 to 0:52.

adegan.narasi: Jari jemariku gemetar hebat saat menekan tombol putar untuk yang terakhir kali.
adegan.gambar: Trembling thumb pressing the play icon on the dark phone interface in the dim room.

adegan.narasi: Suara napas berat itu makin jelas, seolah pemiliknya berdiri tepat di sampingku.
adegan.gambar: The young man frozen in terror, shadows stretching unnaturally on the wall right beside his shoulder.

adegan.narasi: Tepat pada detik terakhir, terdengar suara bisikan dingin, "Dia nggak sendirian."
adegan.gambar: A pale, unnaturally wide-mouthed shadowy figure whispering right near the young man's ear from behind.

adegan.narasi: Bulu kudukku berdiri seraya menatap layar ponsel yang perlahan mati sendiri.
adegan.gambar: The phone screen suddenly goes completely pitch black, reflecting the young man's terrified facial expression.

part.pertanyaan: Siapa yang merekam selama ini? Tulis tebakanmu.
part.caption: Mendatangi kos pacar tapi HP-nya mati. Lalu dari mana voice note baru ini berasal?

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Tanpa berpikir panjang, aku langsung meluncur cepat menuju ke kos pacarku.
adegan.gambar: A young man riding a automatic motorcycle on a dark empty city street under pale streetlights.

adegan.narasi: Sampai di sana, aku mengetuk pintu kamarnya dengan perasaan yang sangat cemas.
adegan.gambar: The young man standing outside a boarding house room door in a narrow hallway, knocking frantically.

adegan.narasi: Dia membuka pintu sambil mengucek mata, kaget melihatku datang mendadak tengah malam.
adegan.gambar: A young Indonesian woman in sleepwear opening the door of her dimly lit room, rubbing her eye with a sleepy, confused face.

adegan.narasi: Dia menunjukkannya langsung: HP miliknya ternyata sudah mati kehabisan baterai sejak sore.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a dead black smartphone lying on a desk in the girl's room. Underneath the dark wooden bed frame in the background, a pale slender hand stretches out from the deep shadow.

adegan.narasi: "Aku beneran tidur dari tadi sore, kok," ucap pacarku dengan wajah bingung.
adegan.gambar: The young woman gesturing with her hands while talking to the worried young man in her bedroom doorway.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba ponsel di genggamanku bergetar kencang menandakan ada notifikasi pesan baru.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the young man's hand holding his smartphone as it vibrates glowing with a new incoming audio message notification.

adegan.narasi: Ada pesan suara baru masuk, dikirim tepat dari nomor telepon milik pacarku.
adegan.gambar: The phone screen showing a new incoming voice note notification from 'Pacar' sent right now.

adegan.narasi: Padahal ponsel milik pacarku jelas-jelas masih tergeletak mati di atas meja kos.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot showing the dead phone on the desk while the young man holds his ringing phone, both looking shocked.

adegan.narasi: Dengan tangan gemetar, aku nekat menekan tombol putar pesan suara terbaru itu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of young man pressing play on the new voice note audio bar.

adegan.narasi: Di latar belakang voice note, terdengar jelas derum suara kipas angin berputar.
adegan.gambar: The young man bringing the phone speaker closer to his ear with an expression of pure disbelief.

adegan.narasi: Bukan cuma itu, lagu favoritku yang sengaja kuputar di kamar juga terdengar.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the young man's dilated eyes showing terror as he listens to the audio.

adegan.narasi: Pesan itu direkam dari dalam kamarku sendiri, padahal aku sedang di rumahnya.
adegan.gambar: The young man dropping his jaw in terror, looking away toward the direction of his home.

part.pertanyaan: Pernah nggak kamu merasa ada yang memperhatikanmu saat tidur? Coba cerita!
part.caption: Misteri HP tua di kamar dan rekaman selama satu bulan penuh. Siapa yang tidur di kolong kasur?

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Aku langsung berlari keluar kos dan memacu motor kembali ke kamarku.
adegan.gambar: The young man rushing frantically out of the building doorway into the night darkness.

adegan.narasi: Sampai di depan rumah, suasana sangat gelap dan pintu kamar sedikit terbuka.
adegan.gambar: Exterior of a dimly lit Indonesian house at night, the bedroom door slightly ajar with dark ambient light inside.

adegan.narasi: Di dalam kamar, kipas angin menyala dan lagu favoritku masih terus berputar.
adegan.gambar: Dark bedroom interior with an electric fan rotating on the floor. On the unlit blank TV screen in the corner, a faint pale face is reflected.

adegan.narasi: Di atas kasurku, tergeletak satu HP tua yang layarnya sedang menyala terang.
adegan.gambar: An old black smartphone lying face-up on a messy mattress, screen glowing bright green with an audio recording interface.

adegan.narasi: Layar HP memperlihatkan aplikasi perekam suara yang masih aktif merekam kondisi kamar.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the screen showing an ongoing red recording timer actively counting seconds.

adegan.narasi: Aku mendekat perlahan dan memutar folder rekaman yang tersimpan di memori HP.
adegan.gambar: The young man reaching out trembling hands towards the phone on his bed.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku serasa berhenti saat melihat puluhan file rekaman tersimpan rapi di sana.
adegan.gambar: The phone screen displaying a long list of recorded audio files labeled with dates over the past month.

adegan.narasi: Tanggal rekaman tertulis lengkap, terus berurutan setiap malam sejak satu bulan lalu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on file timestamps showing daily recordings starting from 30 days ago at exactly 03:00 AM.

adegan.narasi: Aku menekan salah satu file dan mendengarkannya dengan napas tersengal ketakutan.
adegan.gambar: The young man holding the phone to his ear, sweat dripping down his pale terrified face.

adegan.narasi: Dari awal sampai akhir, isinya hanya suara napas beratku sendiri saat tidur.
adegan.gambar: Shot of the young man looking down at the mattress, realization dawning upon him.

adegan.narasi: Seseorang selalu bersembunyi di kamarku, merekamku tidur nyenyak tiap jam tiga pagi.
adegan.gambar: Low-angle shot looking under the bed frame into the pitch-black gap beneath the mattress.

adegan.narasi: Dan saat aku menengok ke bawah kasur, sepasang mata pucat menatapku balik.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up under the bed: two glowing pale eyes staring out from absolute darkness right at the camera.
